children.text: Greeting & Grandparents
children.cn: 问候与祖父母介绍

children.text: Dear Dave,
children.cn: 亲爱的戴夫：
children.notes: 书信开头称呼
children.statement: 本句为信件给出的开头称呼。
children.explanation: 题干已给出，不计入总词数。

children.text: How are you? I want to show you a photo of my family.
children.cn: 你好吗？我想给你看一张我的全家福。
children.notes: show sb. sth. = 给某人看某物；a photo of = 一张……的照片
children.statement: 本句为题干中给出的问候与引入语句。
children.explanation: 题干开头已给出，按规则不计入总词数。

children.text: This is my grandfather, and he is 65 years old.
children.cn: 这是我的祖父，他今年65岁。
children.notes: grandfather = 祖父/外祖父；years old = ……岁
children.statement: “years old” 用于表达年龄。
children.explanation: 65 years old 表示六十五岁。

children.text: And this is my grandmother, who is 64 years old.
children.cn: 这是我的祖母，她今年64岁。
children.notes: grandmother = 祖母/外祖母
children.statement: 句中使用了定语从句来补充说明祖母的年龄。
children.explanation: who引导非限制性定语从句修饰grandmother。

children.text: They are retired and stay at home happily.
children.cn: 他们退休了，开心地待在家里。
children.notes: stay at home = 待在家里；happily = 开心地（副词）
children.statement: “happily” 是副词，修饰动词短语 stay at home。
children.explanation: happily 在句中作状语修饰动词 stay。

children.text: Parents & Self
children.cn: 父母职业与自我介绍

children.text: These are my parents, and they are both 35 years old.
children.cn: 这些是我的父母，他们俩都是35岁。
children.notes: parents = 父母双亲；both = 两个都
children.statement: “both” 指代父母两个人。
children.explanation: both 表示两者都，置于 be 动词 are 之后。

children.text: My mother Zhang Li is a helpful English teacher in a high school.
children.cn: 我的妈妈张莉是一所高中的乐于助人的英语老师。
children.notes: English teacher = 英语老师；high school = 高中
children.statement: “Zhang Li” 是 mother 的同位语。
children.explanation: Zhang Li 具体说明 mother 的名字，为同位语结构。
children.keywords: mother, Zhang Li, English teacher, high school

children.text: My father Li Wei is a kind doctor and works in a hospital.
children.cn: 我的爸爸李伟是一名善良的医生，在一所医院工作。
children.notes: doctor = 医生；work in a hospital = 在医院工作
children.statement: “works” 为第三人称单数形式，与主语 My father 保持一致。
children.explanation: 主语为第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语动词加-s。
children.keywords: father, Li Wei, doctor, works in a hospital

children.text: Look! The cheerful girl in the red dress is me.
children.cn: 看！穿红裙子的那个开朗女孩就是我。
children.notes: in the red dress = 穿着红裙子（介词短语作定语）
children.statement: “in the red dress” 作后置定语修饰 girl。
children.explanation: 介词 in + 颜色/服装 表示穿着。
children.keywords: girl, in the red dress, me

children.text: Conclusion & Closing
children.cn: 家庭总结与书信结尾

children.text: I have a warm and happy family.
children.cn: 我有一个温馨幸福的家庭。
children.notes: warm and happy = 温馨幸福的
children.statement: 本句概括表达对家庭的情感与评价。
children.explanation: 总结全文，升华主题。

children.text: Can you tell me something about yours?
children.cn: 你能告诉我关于你家庭的一些情况吗？
children.notes: tell sb. about sth. = 告诉某人关于某事；yours = 你的家庭（名词性物主代词）
children.statement: “yours” 在句中相当于 your family。
children.explanation: yours 为名词性物主代词，避免与前面 family 重复。

children.text: Yours, Li Juan
children.cn: 你的，李娟
children.notes: 信件落款署名
children.statement: 本句为题干中给出的信件结尾落款。
children.explanation: 题干已给出，不计入总词数。

children.text: Greeting & Grandparents
children.cn: 问候与祖父母介绍

children.text: Dear Dave,
children.cn: 亲爱的戴夫：
children.notes: 书信开头称呼
children.statement: 本句为信件给出的开头称呼。
children.explanation: 题干已给出，两篇范文保持完全一致。

children.text: How are you? I want to show you a photo of my family.
children.cn: 你好吗？我想给你看一张我的全家福。
children.notes: show sb. sth. = 给某人看某物；a photo of = 一张……的照片
children.statement: 本句为题干中给出的问候与引入语句。
children.explanation: 题干开头已给出，按规则不计入总词数。

children.text: In the front row, you can see my loving grandparents who are in their sixties.
children.cn: 在前排，你可以看到我慈爱的祖父母，他们都六十多岁了。
children.notes: in the front row = 在前排；in one's sixties = 在某人六十多岁时
children.statement: “who” 引导定语从句修饰 grandparents。
children.explanation: 定语从句丰富了句式层次并准确描述了年龄阶段。
children.keywords: front row, loving grandparents, in their sixties

children.text: Although they are retired, they still enjoy planting flowers and cooking delicious food for us.
children.cn: 虽然他们已经退休了，但他们仍然喜欢种花和为我们烹饪美味佳肴。
children.notes: although = 尽管；enjoy doing sth. = 喜爱做某事
children.statement: “Although” 引导让步状语从句。
children.explanation: although 引导从句时，主句不再使用 but。
children.keywords: Although, retired, planting flowers, delicious food

children.text: Parents & Self
children.cn: 父母职业与自我介绍

children.text: Standing behind them are my wonderful parents, both of whom are 35 years old.
children.cn: 站在他们身后的是我优秀的父母，他们两人都是35岁。
children.notes: 倒装句结构；both of whom = 他们两人都（非限制性定语从句）
children.statement: 句首现在分词短语引导倒装句，生动展示照片方位。
children.explanation: Standing behind them are... 为完全倒装结构。
children.keywords: Standing behind, wonderful parents, both of whom

children.text: My mother, Zhang Li, teaches English patiently at a local senior high school.
children.cn: 我的母亲张莉在当地一所高中耐心地教英语。
children.notes: patiently = 耐心地（副词）；senior high school = 高中
children.statement: “patiently” 为副词修饰动词 teaches。
children.explanation: 副词修饰动词体现语言的生动与准确性。
children.keywords: mother, Zhang Li, teaches English, patiently

children.text: Meanwhile, my father, Li Wei, works as a responsible doctor in a nearby general hospital.
children.cn: 与此同时，我的父亲李伟在附近一家综合医院担任一名尽责的医生。
children.notes: Meanwhile = 同时；work as = 担任……工作；responsible = 负责任的
children.statement: “Meanwhile” 作为连接副词，使行文衔接自然流畅。
children.explanation: Meanwhile 承接父母两人的职业介绍。
children.keywords: Meanwhile, father, Li Wei, responsible doctor, hospital

children.text: The energetic girl standing in the middle with a sweet smile is me.
children.cn: 中间那个带着甜美微笑、充满活力的女孩就是我。
children.notes: energetic = 充满活力的；with a sweet smile = 带着甜美微笑
children.statement: “standing in the middle...” 为分词短语作后置定语。
children.explanation: 现在分词短语作定语修饰 girl。
children.keywords: energetic girl, in the middle, sweet smile

children.text: Conclusion & Closing
children.cn: 家庭总结与书信结尾

children.text: We always support each other and create sweet memories together.
children.cn: 我们总是相互支持，共同创造甜蜜的回忆。
children.notes: support each other = 相互支持；create memories = 创造回忆
children.statement: “each other” 意为彼此、相互。
children.explanation: 体现了家庭成员之间互相关爱的浓厚氛围。
children.keywords: support each other, create sweet memories

children.text: Could you please share some stories and photos of your family with me?
children.cn: 你能和我分享一些你家人的故事和照片吗？
children.notes: Could you please do sth. = 你能做某事吗（委婉礼貌请求）；share sth. with sb. = 与某人分享某物
children.statement: “Could you please...” 表达礼貌客气的请求语气。
children.explanation: 比一般的 Can you... 更加得体委婉。
children.keywords: Could you please, share stories, photos, with me

children.text: Yours, Li Juan
children.cn: 你的，李娟
children.notes: 信件落款署名
children.statement: 本句为题干中给出的信件结尾落款。
children.explanation: 题干已给出，不计入总词数。
